rule_text: When wide-leg trousers are explicit in the query, a fitted top or cardigan is a documented proportion option.
For an explicitly casual jacket, a tee, polo or casual shirt is an appropriate base-layer direction.
When a cropped top is explicit, high-waisted trousers or a high-waisted skirt are directly supported bottom directions.
For an explicit classic T-shirt, tailored or loose trousers are a directly documented bottom pairing that can remain casual while looking polished.
For an explicitly tailored blazer or coat in workwear, tailored trousers are a supported bottom direction.
For an explicit black-tie menswear request, prefer black patent or highly polished formal shoes.
For an explicit casual tee, a relaxed jacket such as a denim jacket or bomber is category-appropriate when the request remains casual.
For explicit black-tie footwear or a tuxedo context, outerwear must preserve formal evening tone; do not recommend clearly casual jackets.
When boots are explicit in the outfit, a shoulder or handbag is a documented finishing direction.
When jeans or denim are explicit, a leather shoulder bag or woven bag is a documented pairing.
When a skirt is explicit, a shoulder bag is a documented accompaniment to a skirt-led outfit.
When a jacket or coat is explicit with boots, a shoulder bag or tote is a documented finishing direction.
When a sweater knit or jumper dress is explicit with boots, a shoulder bag or top-handle bag is a documented pairing.
When sneakers or trainers are explicit, a shoulder bag, tote or basket bag is a documented finishing direction.
When polished footwear is explicit with a trouser, skirt, short, tank or shirt context, a shoulder bag, clutch or tote is a documented finishing direction.
When a top shirt tee tank or blouse is explicit with polished footwear or a skirt or trouser context, a shoulder or tote bag is a documented finishing direction.
For an explicit T-shirt being smartened within a preppy request, pleated trousers are a directly supported bottom direction.
For an explicit formal clutch or elegant top-handle bag, polished stilettos, kitten heels or polished flats are supported shoe categories.
When trousers pants or shorts are explicit, a shoulder bag tote or clutch is a documented finishing direction.
When ankle booties or booties are explicit, a shoulder bag or tote is a documented finishing direction.
When pumps heels stilettos or wedges are explicit, a shoulder bag or clutch is a documented finishing direction.
When flat shoes slippers loafers or oxfords are explicit, a shoulder bag or basket bag is a documented finishing direction.
When a top tee tank blouse or shirt is explicit, a shoulder or tote bag is a documented finishing direction.
With explicit pumps or heels and a skirt or dress, a shoulder bag is a documented bag direction.
With explicit flat shoes and a dress, skirt or denim context, a raffia or basket bag is a documented bag direction.
With an explicit top plus a skirt, denim or trouser context, a shoulder or tote bag is a documented bag direction.
With explicit wedges and a tank, trouser, short or skirt context, a shoulder or tote bag is a documented bag direction.
